0022600147.text: The Utah Jazz (1-4, 5th in the Northwest and 13th in the West, 3 games back) host the Portland Trail Blazers (3-1, 2nd in the Northwest and 5th in the West, 0.5 games back) in the Jazz's sixth game of the 2026-27 season, with Utah on a three-game losing streak and 1-3 at home. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while Lauri Markkanen (wrist) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, and Portland, on a one-game losing streak after going 2-0 on the road, is without Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), with Ja Morant (hamstring) and Robert Williams III (knee) also day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Jazz lost 0-4 to Portland, most recently 124-114 in Portland on March 13, 2026.
